# ghost_team_membership (Resource)

Adds a user to a team, as a member or a maintainer. **The user must already be a member of the team's organization**: Ghost refuses anyone else, and organization invitations can't be sent with an API token, so invite them in the web UI first. Teams can't be created with an API token either, so the team must already exist: look it up with the `ghost_team` or `ghost_organization_teams` data source, or name it with `team_slug`. You must be an organization admin, or a maintainer of the team to add and remove members; only admins can change `role`. Adding someone who is already in the team adopts them and sets their role. Destroying the resource removes the user from the team, not from the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ghost_team" "core" {
  organization = "my-org"
  slug         = "core"
}

# Make an existing member of the organization a maintainer of the team.
# Organization invitations can't be sent with an API token, so invite the
# user in the Ghost web UI first.
resource "ghost_team_membership" "alice" {
  organization = "my-org"
  team_id      = data.ghost_team.core.id
  username     = "alice"
  role         = "maintainer"
}

# Or name the team by its slug. role defaults to "member".
resource "ghost_team_membership" "bob" {
  organization = "my-org"
  team_slug    = "core"
  username     = "bob"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The slug of the team's organization, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. Changing it to another organization forces a new resource; changing only its case doesn't.
- `username` (String) The username of the user to add, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. They must already be a member of `organization`. Changing it to another user forces a new resource; changing only its case doesn't.

### Optional

- `role` (String) `member` (the default) or `maintainer`. A maintainer can add and remove the team's members. Changing it updates the resource in place.
- `team_id` (String) The team's ID, e.g. `data.ghost_team.example.id`. It never changes, even if the team is renamed. Exactly one of `team_id` and `team_slug` must be set; when `team_slug` is set, this is the ID it names. Changing the team forces a new resource.
- `team_slug` (String) The team's slug, matched case-insensitively. Exactly one of `team_id` and `team_slug` must be set; when `team_id` is set, this is the team's current slug. A slug changes when the team is renamed, so prefer `team_id` where you can. Changing it to another team's slug forces a new resource; changing it to the same team's new slug doesn't.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization, team ID and username, `organization:team_id:username`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A team membership is imported by the organization, the team's ID or slug,
# and the username, "organization:team:username".
terraform import ghost_team_membership.alice my-org:DG4eRcoHLcE1RfixZDetBcBzEQBBYIbb:alice
terraform import ghost_team_membership.bob my-org:core:bob
```
